The '''Grancha Lakand venom mine''' was a [[Venenit queshaaga|Quesh venom]] mine located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]]. It was named after the miner [[Grancha Lakand]], who discovered the venom deposit that the mine later tapped.
